activities.text: Ran the schedule audit in the rain — Criminal Law and Indigenous Legal Traditions at PACI, Contracts readings overdue
Posted the George brief for Rheia's Morning Show — courts and fair rules today
Morning briefing out — bail mark landed at 71, which stung, Crim textbook only in the bag
Recorded the drive-time podcast — Grant and Mann, the pat-down is not a pocket search
Muffin demolished, out the door to PACI — Criminal Law at nine
Family-tree research sprint in full burn — rounds every two hours, digging up ancestors all day
Midday drive-time recorded — Wampum at Niagara, two vessels, one river, lunch skipped
Fridge tech arrived early — stayed home, fan motor swapped, the fridge lives again
Printed Margarine at home — 89 pages later the black ink cratered to 11%, EMA is a library job now
Raced back to PACI and caught the tail of Indigenous Legal Traditions
Bail feedback sorted — Braun meeting booked for Monday lunch, Wholesale Club run moved to later this week
Dinner — buns and dip with rotisserie chicken leftovers, ground chicken in the repaired freezer as a science experiment
Family-tree site live and shipping layout rounds all evening, midterms watch running on the side
HomeView ordered, Genshin servers back early — Furina first when 7.2 opens, then I recharge
